name: Button Hell
desc:
This game has a total of 100K buttons! 🤯

Your job is to find the correct button, but the Rainbow Duck Coin is only obtainable by finding clues and solving the mystery!🔑

Information:
Bronze Duck Coin - 4,000 in stock
Silver Duck Coin - 750 in stock
Golden Duck Coin - 250 in stock
Rainbow Duck Coin - 100 in stock

⚠️ For new servers, the game needs about 5 minutes to fully load all the buttons. ⚠️
